newsitem.title: LIECHTENSTEIN: Hilti sales up nine pct, forecast same.
newsitem.headline: Hilti sales up nine pct, forecast same.

text.p: Hilti AG, a world leader in speciality construction tools and materials, said 1996 group sales rose nine percent to 2.2 billion Swiss francs and the company was sticking to its latest forecast for profits to be around the 1995 level.
Hilti said in a statement the good sales result was achieved despite a difficult start to the year and the weak construction business, especially in the German speaking regions in Europe.
The highest growth rates were recorded in East and Southern Europe, South America and Asia, Hilti said.
Final 1996 financial results will be announced on April 14.
Hilti's 1995 net profit rose 15 percent to 192.5 million francs from 168.0 million in 1994.
